detail: Key (NEW at 61ae00920): R7|fnn-mux-reserve|swallow:ignore-errors:fault at mux.lisp:1870-1872 (ignore-errors around fnn-log-line of ACL2's deferral line, in the accept thread outside the slot lock). A real swallow of a diagnostic write, but the identical pattern is baselined ten times in mux.lisp (fnn-mux-handshake-refused, fnn-mux-tls-log, fnn-mux-take-inbox ...). It changes no decision: the deferral is ACL2's, the line is only the record. Not fixed one-off: re-signalling as fnn-fault from an accept thread changes what a log failure does to the node and should be done uniformly for all mux log sinks.
fix: Route the mux service-log writes through the verified diagnostic sink, or re-signal as fnn-fault uniformly, with host_check --load.
notes: Fixed at 5d2ed7234: the ignore-errors around the deferral line in fnn-mux-reserve is removed; a malformed ACL2 line is fnn-fault's and reaches the accept loop boundary, as fnn-owner-retire-refuse's identical fnn-log-line already does. Key R7|fnn-mux-reserve|swallow:ignore-errors:fault gone, none added. Not changed: the same wrapper in the I/O-loop sinks (fnn-mux-handshake-refused, fnn-mux-tls-log, fnn-mux-z-in, fnn-mux-take-inbox, ...) stays baselined, because a log failure there would end a whole loop with its connections; that is a separate decision for Deputy C. natives_owed: tests/test_native_mux.py, tests/test_native_mux_budget_observe.py (accept path with a pending-accept deferral).
title: fnn-mux-reserve swallows a failure of the once-per-episode deferral service-log line (R7)
